id./param/scenario/cs/b_020_cs_020.pack|cs_: "{var:1}... It's you! It's me, Gemma, your childhood friend!
"Welcome home, {var:1}. You're safe... I heard such awful rumors... I... I...
"You're right, Sandy. I shouldn't cry when I'm this happy...
"Our village has changed a lot, hasn't it? Right after you left for the castle, a general named Jasper came.
"Jasper had cold, heartless eyes. He gathered us in the village square and ordered his soldiers... to kill us all.
"But we're alive. Another man stopped Jasper, saying there was no need to take our lives.
"The village was burned and we were locked in the castle, but that man was very kind. No one hurt us...
"Hee hee. Sorry, sorry. {var:1} is tired from the long journey. Chat later! Rest first.
"...And someone is waiting for you more than anyone. Come on, {var:1}, follow me!"
